verse.meaning_english: They ascended the mountain, which had fearsome caves with large serpents, resounded with the loud and terrible cries of numerous birds, and was crowded with elephants, boars, lions, cattle, and deer amidst its large sāla trees.

commentaries.content: समेत्यादि - समहा फणीन्यत एव भीमानि बिलानि विवराणि यत्र भूरीणां विहङ्गमानां तुमुलो ऽनेकप्रकार उरुर्महान् घोरो रौद्रो विरावो यत्र वारणादिभिः स्कन्धकर्षणार्थिभिः सङ्कुला महासाला यत्र ॥
